description: RALEIGH – Yesterday, a national news outlet released a devastating story detailing how violent criminals released by Roy Cooper went into Catawba County and committed horrific crimes. Three individuals whom Roy Cooper released from prison before they had served their full sentences murdered a 16-month-old child, assaulted other children, and dragged a man down the street under their car. Roy Cooper’s soft-on-crime policies and Roy Cooper’s soft-on-crime Judges have left North Carolina families devastated in the wake of Cooper's efforts to limit prison time for violent criminals.

title: ICYMI: A 16-Month-Old Child Was Brutally Murdered By a Violent Criminal Whom Roy Cooper Released Early from Prison – Michael Whatley for Senate
